title: Update README to reflect current repo contents
body:
README's "What's Inside?" section was a stale, flat list missing ~60% of the repo's subjects.

## Changes

- **Replaced** flat subject list with structured sections per category: CS (University Y1–Y4), CS (Personal), Calculus (University + Personal), Statistics, Liberal Arts, Homework
- **CS University** now rendered as a table keyed by year/semester, surfacing previously undocumented courses: Databases, COA, SWE, Simulation, ISS, OS, Networks, Web
- **Added missing sections**: Personal CS notes (Deep Learning, Leetcode patterns, ML), Liberal Arts (Economics, Finance, FDE), and Homework breakdown by year
- **Navigation** blurb updated to mention PDF output and LaTeX/Markdown sources explicitly
